# Netherlands

> [!summary] Data available
> Moderately covered: 28 [[FmLAMA]] and 32 [[WorldCuisines]] dishes, [[RecipeDB2]] ≈700 Dutch recipes and [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 224, but no Dutch FCT (NEVO) in the vault. Human evidence is good: [[Exposome-Explorer]] has 837 Dutch rows (EPIC-NL, NEO, LifeLines, Generation R).

## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈700 recipes labelled Dutch (region "Belgian" 1,060, shared with Belgium); not released.
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 224 recipes tagged `dutch`. [[CulinaryDB]]: 40 recipes (`Misc.: Dutch`).
- Dish inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 32 dishes (12 Netherlands-only; poffertjes, pannenkoek, pepernoot); [[FmLAMA]] 28 dishes (370 rows; stamppot, hachee, Hollandse Nieuwe); [[World Wide Dishes]] 5 (4 Netherlands-only). Ingredient lists only.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table for this country is in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] (and [[FooDB]] / [[Phenol-Explorer]] for compounds) by name matching. The Dutch NEVO table is not a candidate.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 170 plants; [[NPASS]] 4 pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- **Human-cohort evidence:** [[Exposome-Explorer]] 837 rows (303 concentrations, 350 correlations, 130 reproducibility, 54 cancer associations). EPIC-NL gives 49 of the cancer rows (overall: breast 19, colorectal 15, pancreatic 12); NEO, LifeLines and Generation R give biomarker ranges.
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] ETHNOBOT 212 records (36 taxa; includes Curaçao/Aruba folded in); [[KNApSAcK Family]] World lists the country (edible/medicinal species records; counts for European countries were not scraped).
- Global backbone via [[Global]]: [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[CTD]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions.

## Gaps
- No Dutch FCT (NEVO) and no Dutch-language recipe corpus.
